regions.full_page: God bless you and yours. Only late last night did I get to read your kind favor of March 1st, duely received and noted. Many thanks for same. I rather regret, however, that I failed to find the sister's name whose condition is lamented. I wanted to enroll her in the Seraphic lass Association - a great part of the secret (?) of the many favors reported back to our monasteries, as answers to prayer. I shall enroll her any- how, as best I know, in the hope that possibly the merciful God may deign to smile some way at our "daring simplicity". Adored be His blessed de- signs. In the mean time please send me her name for registration. Rather have her write me as she proposed to do and explain the trouble as best she can. Why should she hesitate? Details are not necessary of course. But something personal would naturally be better than a report from some one else. If, as you tell me, she tries I am sure we will be able to help her. We have had cases that I am sure have been more threatening by far than hers, judging from just what you have told me, that have come out better than before afflicted. While waiting to hear from her I am sending you a letter for her, written by one of my reverend brothers to another - ordained just a year apart -- 1911-'12. For five yrs. the elder was hardly ever able to say Holy Mass. Now in his 80th year he says his office and Holy Mass every day. Thanks be to God. I am sure you will all like the letter.
